guidelines.statement: Candidate plans must pass shared hard validators for Factorio legality, collisions, available resources, fluid purity, and scope.
Use only the starter kit and items the factory manufactures; never borrow player inventory or gifted items.
Prefer iron and copper starters first, then stone and mall capacity.
Use approved six-drill mine and smelting modules for later plate capacity; expand against measured demand.
Use logistic bots to supply one or two machines and mall machines.
Once demand and sustained production exceed what one or two bot-fed machines need, switch to direct belt transfers.
Prefer actions that close current goal gaps or unblock them; preserve useful parallel progress.
Prefer the deepest unmet input in the measured bottleneck chain.
Make construction items that outstanding useful builds are short of.
Establish steel before steel-dependent pole and assembler stock is exhausted.
In the current ops adapter, establish a plate's direct starter before its foundation.
Prefer a mine and six-furnace foundation after its plate starter produces; reconcile the same transaction on retries.
Extend an open refinery in place by one six-furnace module, with its mine, while its plate is still short.
Reconcile current material shortfalls and produce missing items before retrying the blocked transaction.
While relevant bots or coverage are advancing, wait or serve independent work.
Retry a construction or coverage wait after observation shows progress or its retry horizon expires.
Prefer gear, cable and circuit producers, then belt capacity, before foundations; preserve their construction budget.
Reserve the funded steel seed's poles before competing builds consume them.
Start the funded steel seed when iron supply is verified and lifecycle admission permits it, including the pioneer-output cycle break.
Retire a starter only after its replacement delivers plates; recover entities and contents with bots.
Retry a material-blocked transaction after its required stock or allocation changes; reuse its existing plan.
Let a feasible mall batch finish; interrupt when its inputs cannot arrive or its lender blocks a more urgent dependency.
Prefer finishing iron, copper and stone starters before foundations consume their reserved drills.
After repeated same-cause failures, prefer a different action until relevant facts change.
After useful output, prefer continuing related work when it still serves current demand.
After several decisions without useful progress, explore an untried feasible operation.
A borrowed cell is a finite batch, not a standing producer; request it for a current shortfall and account for displaced output.
